title: Charmable animal
wikitext:
[[Image:Melandru's Stalker.jpg|right|250px]] [[Charmable animal]]s are a type of [[creature]] that can become an [[animal companion]] by [[target]]ing them with [[Charm Animal]]. Nearly all charmable animals are hostile, but remain [[Foe#Passive foe|passive]] until they take [[damage]] or [[life steal]], are [[target]]ed by a [[skill]] that can target a foe, or an attempt to charm them occurs. They should not be confused with [[beast]]s, animal-like creatures that cannot be charmed. ==By campaign and region== {| class="hidelist" style="margin:0.5em; border:1px solid {{R-color|border}}; border-collapse:collapse;" cellpadding="2" cellspacing="0" rules="all" |- style="background:{{R-color|background}}" ! |} ==By Zaishen Menagerie location== [[File:Zaishen Menagerie Animals Locations.png|thumb|275px|right|Locations of all the animals in the Menagerie.]] {{:Charmable_animal/Animals_by_menagerie_location}} == By damage type == {{:Animal companion/Types of damage}} ==Notes== * Pets can be unlocked through the [[Zaishen Menagerie Grounds#Service costs|Zaishen Menagerie]]. * Non-prestige pets can be unlocked through the [[Pet Unlock Pack]]. * When killed, charmable animals do not [[drop]] any [[item]]s, with these exceptions: ** During [[special event]]s, they will drop [[seasonal item]]s (with the same frequency that [[foe]]s do). ** In [[Guild Wars Eye of the North|Eye of the North]], they drop [[map piece]]s. * Some NPCs have animal allies which look like pets; they cannot be tamed by players or heroes: ** [[Carlotta]] is the spider companion of [[Shadow]]; ** [[Devourer (pet)|Devourer]]s accompany [[Charr]] during [[The Rise of the White Mantle]] and [[Charr-broiled Plans]]; ** [[Old Mac]] and his devourer ally [[Joe]] appear in a couple of Prophecies quests and in the [[Norn Fighting Tournament]]. ** Drake [[Toma]] is a beast tamed by the people of [[Ronjok]]; ** [[Drake (pet)|Drake]]s appear as companions to some [[Peacekeeper]]s; ** [[Impressive Warthog]] is an ally tamed by [[Nehdukah]] in [[Plains of Jarin]]; ** White wolf [[Snow]] is an ally of [[Master Seeker Nathaniel]] in [[Griffon's Mouth]]. * Charmable animals killed count towards rewards for [[Vanquish]]ing, but do not count towards accumulating points through [[bounty|bounties]] or [[bounty-like blessing]]s. * Charmable animals do not appear on the [[compass]] unless they become hostile. ** They will attack whoever caused them to become hostile, i.e. either your party or [[PvE]] foes. If your party causes a charmable animal to become hostile and then run away from it to lose its [[aggro]], it will not attack any PvE foes that enters its [[Danger Zone]]. * Even though still remaining their base level, their armor is increased to 100-101 in HM. {{Bug|On rare occasions, a charmable animal ''displays'' the name of a foe within the same zone or a foe might show the pet's name and level.
